draft.title: Calculated with draft parameters
draft.body: These parameters still wait for an agronomist's sign-off; the result may change after it:

params.eff_rain_fraction: share of rain entering the soil

assumptions.fallow_before_the_day: The field is assumed to have been fallow for the {days} days before the day. The crop history arrives with Field Memory (phase 5).
assumptions.regional_weather: Rain comes from NASA POWER. It is a regional product of roughly 50 km resolution, not a measurement taken on the field.
assumptions.no_sensor: There is no sensor data, so the range is shown wide. A sensor (phase 7) corrects the model state.
assumptions.range_from_soil_and_fallow_efficiency: The low and high values come from the water range of the soil texture and from the fallow efficiency shifted by ±{delta}.
assumptions.sensor_corrects_decision_day: The water on the decision day is read from calibrated field sensors and replaces the model state.
assumptions.range_from_sensor_band: The range is a narrow band of ±{bandMm} mm around the sensor reading (provisional value).

charts.storageAria: Line chart of the water stored in the root zone and the soil capacity
charts.et0Aria: Line chart of daily reference evapotranspiration

et0Blocker.no_elevation: ET0 needs the elevation of the field. It is written to the field profile when NASA data is fetched.

season.blocked: The lengths of the growth stages for {crop} are not set yet (config/crops.yaml). The agronomist sets them for the Konya calendar. Until then the crop season is not calculated and no invented value is shown.

rotation.noFieldsDescription: Rotations are compared on a field's 25 years of data. Add a field first.
rotation.summary: {field} · {count} seasons ({first}–{last}) · the current rotation is user-supplied

provisional.title: Computed with provisional values
provisional.body: Crop stage lengths, sowing dates, irrigation efficiency and the legume choice are starting values that await agronomist sign-off. The results show the method; they are not for decisions:

A.rationale: The pattern the farmer knows; the baseline.
A.evidence: In this version the user states the rotation; the Landsat and MODIS history arrives with Field Memory.
A.gap: Satellites separate cropped from fallow, not the crop species.
A.risk: The farmer must confirm the crop sequence.

B.rationale: The year's water, not the calendar, decides.
B.evidence: Storage on the decision day, precipitation and the 25-season balance.
B.benefit: No wasted sowing or irrigation in dry years.
B.gap: Satellite soil moisture is coarse where there is no sensor.
B.risk: The threshold must be calibrated to the soil type.

C.rationale: Fixes nitrogen and shortens bare-field time.
C.evidence: The legume's water need and the 25-season balance.
C.gap: No local yield or market price.
C.risk: The variety's tolerance to cold and disease.

metrics.enough: Water was enough in {sufficient} of {valid} sowings
metrics.stress: Mean stress days in the sensitive stage

assumptions.rotation_user_supplied: The current rotation was typed in; Field Memory (phase 5) does not exist yet.
assumptions.fallow_between_seasons: With no crop the soil keeps part of the rain under the fallow rule.
assumptions.no_sensor: No sensor correction (phase 7); the range is shown wide.
assumptions.regional_weather: Weather is the regional NASA POWER value, not measured on the field.
assumptions.kc_mid_table_value: Kc mid is the table value, not corrected for the local climate.
assumptions.range_from_soil_and_rain: The range comes from the soil's water range and the rain share.

fieldMemory.source: Source: NASA/USGS Landsat 8 and 9 Collection 2 surface reflectance (30 m) and NASA MODIS MOD13Q1 / MYD13Q1 version 061 (250 m), from the public Microsoft Planetary Computer catalogue. The clear pixels inside the field boundary are used.

provisional.title: The cropped threshold is provisional
provisional.body: A field counts as cropped when its highest NDVI in a season reaches {value}. That is a starting value taken from the typical range of winter cereals at their peak against bare or weedy fallow; an agronomist must calibrate it with fields of known history.

fieldMemory.unknownWarning: {count} seasons have too few clear images (cloud, snow or missing data) and were left "unknown". Confirm them by hand.
fieldMemory.limits: This method separates cropped from fallow; it does not know the crop species or winter from summer crops. Landsat (30 m) suits small parcels far better than MODIS (250 m, about 6 hectares); Landsat can leave gaps in cloudy seasons.
